issues.description: The problem statement text (task description) specifies addGuestStudents(String) as the required method signature, but the UML diagram in the same problem statement and the solution implementation use addGuestStudents(int). This parameter type mismatch can lead students to implement the wrong signature (using String) and then fail tests or produce compilation/signature mismatches since the intended parameter type is int.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the textual task description in problem_statement.md to specify addGuestStudents(int) so it matches the UML and the intended implementation. Ensure all references to the parameter type for addGuestStudents are consistent (int) across the problem statement and template instructions.
